name: Code Editor
tagline: Edit JSON, XML and other code in a multiline text column, with Monaco.

presets.name: JSON, light
presets.description: A JSON document with validation on and a Format button in the strip beneath the editor.

presets.name: Two faults
presets.description: A trailing comma and a comment: the first is named in the strip, both are marked in the editor, and Format still tidies what parses.

presets.name: Dark, fit to content
presets.description: Forced dark theme, and the editor sized to its document up to 400px rather than a fixed box.

presets.name: XML
presets.description: An XML document; well-formedness is checked by the browser's own parser.
